summary.name: Apache NetBeans
summary.one_liner: Apache NetBeans is an open-source integrated development environment (IDE) for building applications in Java, PHP and other languages.
use_cases: editing code with syntax and semantic highlighting
contributing to an open source IDE
summary.what_it_does: Apache NetBeans is described as more than a text editor. It highlights source code both syntactically and semantically and lets users refactor code with a set of tools. It provides editors, wizards and templates to help create applications in Java, PHP and many other languages. The page states it can be installed on any operating system that supports Java, including Windows, Linux, Mac OS X and BSD. The page also points to mailing lists and social channels, and invites contributions through pull requests, issue filing and discussions.
notable: Semantic and syntactic source code highlighting with refactoring tools
Wizards and templates for Java, PHP and other languages
Runs on any OS that supports Java
caveats: Requires Java to run, as stated by the page's cross-platform claim
